title: Manufacturing Analytics for Engineers: practice files (Power BI)
description:
Free practice files for the video course Manufacturing Analytics for Engineers (Power BI). Contents: a synthetic dataset for a fictional plant (Engxtech Manufacturing: production, maintenance, sensor readings, quality inspections and monthly energy exports, April–September 2026), Power BI start and finished files for 9 sections, a formula cheat sheet and a capstone brief.

All data is synthetic; no real company data is included. Power BI is a trademark of the Microsoft group of companies; this resource is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
notes: Fictional plant; all numbers synthetic. Course videos: YouTube @VijayakumarYeddula.
